title: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next NVFP4 QAD on two Sparks
evidence_scope: Revision 60215d26cf5e42c2db6128774032d57fc62678da (branch qad-step5500-ple1000) with HC token-row prefill ownership, a BF16 target LM head, MXFP8 hyper-connection down/injection projections for batches of at most 16 rows, the fused rotary-embedding op, MTP drafts sampled from the draft distribution with the draft's MXFP8 experts on the humming MoE backend, and RoCEnante all-reduces for up to 64 decode rows. On installer image dev-20260927-b12xcache-cuda1342-nccl2323-status032, an installation through install.sh on one pair, adopting the checkpoint copies on the Sparks, passed 7 of 7 functional checks (counting, arithmetic, code, tool calls, image, thinking) and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate response, and decoded 54.6 / 202 / 296 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 3,663 tokens/s (performance/records/images/dev-20260927-b12xcache-qwen38-flash-next-tp2-20260927.md). On installer image dev-20261001-kraken-cuda1342-nccl2323-status034, an installation through install.sh on one pair passed the same 7 functional checks and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate or failed response, and decoded 53.6 / 201 / 296 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 3,660 tokens/s (performance/records/images/dev-20261001-kraken-qwen38-flash-next-tp2-20261001.md). On installer image dev-20261004-kraken-cuda1342-nccl2323-status034, an installation through install.sh on two Sparks of a four-Spark ring passed 7 of 7 functional checks and a 256-request correctness screen with no degenerate or failed response, and decoded 52.2 / 200 / 289 tokens/s at 1 / 8 / 16 streams at temperature 1.0 with 64K-token prefill at 3,630 tokens/s, medians of two runs (performance/records/images/dev-20261004-kraken-qwen38-flash-next-tp2-20261004.md). Timings on earlier images are single runs; not serving-qualified. No release qualification covers this revision.
